scope: Node VM with minimal DOM mocks. This does not exercise a browser, layout, accessibility tree or real storage.

checks.name: Dialogue exposes three distinct reply branches, follow-ups and endings
Settings preview changes DOM classes and unsaved marker
Save survives a new app boot using the same local storage
Cancel restores saved volume and comfort settings
Restore defaults remains a draft until saved and can be cancelled
Both hash routes navigate without losing the current conversation
Unavailable storage reports failed save without claiming persistence
Malformed persisted values are safely normalized
Every runtime file reference is local and resolves inside run-02
